steps.adjacentText: Heat the wok now over high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of oil and the diced onion. Stir-fry until the onions are translucent. Next, add the diced ham and Chinese Roast Pork, and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes, being sure to heat the rice uniformly. Use your wok spatula to flatten out and break up any remaining rice clumps.
Add the shrimp and peas, and stir fry continuously for another 2 minutes until the rice is heated through.

alternateImages.adjacentText: Same shrimp and peas stir-fry phase; alternate angle, not a separate operation.

steps.adjacentText: Next, mix in the scrambled eggs, scallions, chopped lettuce, and white pepper. Lettuce is one of the signature ingredients of this young chow fried rice providing a refreshing crunch so be sure not to overcook it!

steps.adjacentText: 准备食材。泰国香米300克、胡萝卜丁适量、青豆适量、玉米粒适量、黄瓜适量、鸡蛋两个、香肠适量、虾仁适量、香葱适量。
将香米淘洗干净，然后放到电饭煲中，加适量的清水开始煮饭，饭煮好后，晾凉备用。
黄瓜切丁、香肠切丁、鸡蛋打散、香葱切碎备用。
虾仁中加半只蛋清、一小勺淀粉抓均后腌制10分钟备用。
锅中加适量清水，水烧开后加将玉米、青豆、胡萝卜倒入锅中焯水备用。
锅中加少许油，油热后倒入虾仁滑炒。虾仁变白成熟即可盛出备用。
锅中加少许油，油热后将玉米、青豆、胡萝卜、黄瓜、香肠倒入锅中，加入少许盐煸炒匀后盛出备用。
锅中加少许油，油热之后倒入蛋液，边炒边将鸡蛋打散。
将米饭倒入锅中翻炒匀均。
将各种蔬菜倒入锅中翻炒匀均。
将虾仁倒入锅中，然后滴少许香油翻炒匀均后即可出锅。
